summary: RptMnuStudentEvaluations is a user control in the HSPnet web application responsible for displaying and generating reports about student evaluations. It provides an interface for users to select Departments and Programs, specify a date range, and produce Excel or HTML reports for student evaluations using backend data retrieval processes. The control includes extensive validation, dropdown population logic, and mechanisms to render the report data in the UI.
purpose: To facilitate the generation, viewing, and exporting of student evaluation reports by allowing users to filter based on department, program, and date range, and to validate input and display results in a user-friendly format.

workflows.name: Page Initialization and PreRender
steps: On Page_Load, control logic may be initialized (but no explicit logic found).
On Page_PreRender, if UserSession is present, load description and options for Student Evaluations report.
Setup JavaScript variables for field client IDs.

workflows.name: Dropdown Change Handlers
steps: When ddDepartment dropdown changes, fill Program dropdown with programs related to the selected department.

workflows.name: Report Generation
steps: Clicking the 'Run Excel' or report button triggers parameter setup: DepartmentID, ProgramID, DateFrom, DateTo.
Procedure 'ReportStudentEvaluations' is called with current session and filter parameters.
Fetch report data, generate report HTML or CSV.
Display report HTML in pnlReportHTML if available.

workflows.name: Dropdown Population
steps: If UserSession.AllowAllDepartments is true, search agency departments; otherwise, list departments for session agency.
If UserSession.AllowAllPrograms is true, search programs for selected department; otherwise, list programs.
Insert an 'ALL' option at the top of Program dropdown.

business_rules: Department and Program dropdowns are dynamically populated based on user session privileges.
'ALL' option is always included for programs.
validations: RegularExpressionValidator for valid date format on both fields.
CustomValidator1 (details unspecified; presumed for additional logic).
conditions: Populate dropdowns only if UserSession is available.
Populate dropdowns if counts are zero or a DataBind flag is true.
Restrict department/program choices according to session permissions.
system_behavior: Displays report description and options from CodeLookup.
Sets up client JavaScript for form fields.
Handles async postback for JavaScript registration.
Shows report HTML panel if report is generated.
dependencies: UserSession object for authorization and access control.
AJAX Control Toolkit for calendar selection.
Dropdown controls for departments and programs.
exceptions: Dropdown population skips if UserSession is null.
Report panel is not shown if reportHTML is empty.
content_gaps: No details about contents or logic inside CustomValidator1.
